doc.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021

title: Missing the East and goodbyes
summary: Israels says he misses New England and New York after nearly half his life in Portland; they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thanks, Monk. Well I appreciate it. I miss the east, I miss where you are, all of that. That’s my territory. It feels strange to be out here. I’ve been out here half my life almost, not quite, almost, yeah, almost half my life, and it feels like — it’s okay it’s beautiful. The weather’s better. We’re in a blue state in a blue city basically. So things are — it’s not terrible.
But I miss New England, I miss New York, I miss upstate New York and Vermont. That’s home to me. So enjoy the things I’m missing.
Okay. Maybe there’s a song title in there.
Anyway thank you very much for your interest and attention. Is this recorded video as well or just —
Yes. This is going to be on video. And we have a YouTube channel. So I’ll pause our recording and then we’ll say goodbye.
Okay. Thank you very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
